trigger.plain: Buy an hourly close above the daily swing high being tested.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20: the test of the high has failed.
decisions.reason: Test at the prior high, a double stop point (C2/C20): D close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.48, D swing_class HH/HL, W ema_order 9>21. Entry and invalidation sit close together by construction.

trigger.plain: After the pullback turns, an hourly close above Friday's high.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20, turning the higher low into a lower low.
decisions.reason: RETRACEMENT family (C2/C7 approximated, ADX not served): D swing_class HH/HL, D close_vs_swing_high_pct -5.67. H1 swing_class LH/LL and W swing_class LH/LL: the higher low is not yet confirmed, so I wait for the turn.

trigger.plain: Let the pullback reach the 20-day, then buy the hourly close back above it.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close more than 1 ATR under ma_20: the pullback has become a reversal.
decisions.reason: First pullback after fresh highs, the Holy Grail shape (C7, ADX not served): W and D swing_class HH/HL, D close_vs_swing_high_pct -2.74. Price is not yet at the average; I act only when it gets there and turns.
